suites.name: RIO_01
suites.title: RawIQR Origin Audit
suites.finding: rawIQR is a pure function of seed-determined weight sampling + N. Generator (uniform[0.90,1.10]) explains mean (bias=-0.23%). Between-seed variance dominates (ratio=0.097). Topology independent (all |r|<0.1). Decision: Model A.

suites.name: SRA_01
suites.title: Seed Realization Structure Audit
suites.finding: rawIQR is a stable shared seed-level trait across N (cross-N r=0.90-0.95, C1). Between-seed variance=93.6%. Top-10 retention=8/10. Common-70 verification r=1.0000 confirms generator seed-reuse fully explains cross-N consistency. rawIQR independent from rawMean (|r|<0.08). Model A.

decisionModel: Model A: rawIQR is mostly seed realization. Between-seed variance dominates; topology is independent.
primaryFinding: RawIQR variation originates from seed-determined random weight sampling from the uniform[0.90, 1.10] generator. The generator explains the mean rawIQR within 0.23% bias. Between-seed variance is ~10x larger than within-seed variance. Topology and graph structure show no association (all |r| < 0.1). High-rawIQR profiles differ from low-rawIQR only in spread metrics (rawStd, rawIQR), not in central tendency or bounds.
purpose: Investigate what generates rawIQR variation between profiles before SelectAndClassify.
primaryQuestion: What generates rawIQR differences between profiles before SAC/P1 assignment?
supportedFindings: RawIQR mean = 0.0998, matches generator expectation S=0.10 (bias=-0.23%)
Topology and graph structure show no association with rawIQR (all |r|<0.1, all p>0.1)
High-rawIQR profiles differ from low-rawIQR only in spread metrics (rawStd, rawIQR)
Central tendency (rawMean, rawMedian) and bounds (rawMin, rawMax) are identical across rawIQR quartiles
RawIQR distribution is robust under jackknife, random split, and leave-one-N
Generator (uniform[0.90,1.10]) fully explains rawIQR mean value
Seed realization explains rawIQR variation (50% variance explained)
Stop-Low safe. Causal closure blocked. V6 NOT READY.
conditionalFindings: generator-class limited (System.Random uniform, not cryptographic or alternative RNG)
S=0.10 fixed; rawIQR scales with S
hypotheses: RawIQR may scale linearly with S in the weight generator
Alternative RNG implementations may produce different rawIQR distributions
N=65 (the adaptive boundary) may show different rawIQR characteristics
notClaimed: physical N-boundary or physical interpretation of N
